title: Key Vault receipt claims
description: Signed by the Key Vault's own keypair, consumed by Identity. Verbatim from AUTH-KEY-LIFECYCLE-INSTRUCTIONS-v2 Appendix B.4. A receipt authorizes nothing except the one Identity endpoint that consumes it; it is not a bearer credential anywhere else.

jti.description: Single-use. Identity persists consumed values until exp.

op.description: A rotation receipt attests a PENDING state, never a promotion. Promotion happens only via Identity's server-authenticated confirm.

manifestRef.description: Opaque, Vault-minted. The value Identity writes to encryption_key_ref.
